title: YouTube Channel with FlashData
description: YouTube Channel for your AI agent. Uses FlashData Credits; Apify usage is billed separately. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

handle.title: Handle
handle.description: YouTube channel handle, e.g. @Google. Use a handle, not a channel ID or URL.

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Requires youtube_channel access. Get your key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

video_limit.title: Video Limit
video_limit.description: Maximum recent videos (1–100); not the full channel history.
